plaatsen.tekst: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
